extracted.name: Mound Bars
extracted.description: These mound bars have a rich coconut filling on a graham cracker crust topped with chocolate. If you're a fan of Mound candy bars — you're in for a treat!
ingredient_lines: 1 (12 ounce) package semisweet chocolate chips, melted
instruction_lines: Preheat the oven to 350 degrees F (175 degrees C).
Combine graham cracker crumbs, sugar, and melted butter in a bowl; mix to combine and pat into the bottom of a 9x13 inch baking pan. Bake in the preheated oven for 15 minutes. Keep the oven on.
Combine condensed milk and flaked coconut; spread over the crust and continue to bake for 15 minutes.
Spread melted chocolate over coconut layer. Set aside to cool and let chocolate harden, about 1 hour. Cut into squares.
